subject: Mutual action plan — RivenTech phased rollout & data migration windows
messages:
From: Emily Park <emily.park@riventech.com>
To: mina_haddad@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: carlos.mendes@riventech.com
Date: 2028-08-30T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Kickoff + MAP for RivenTech phased rollout

Hi Mina / Ben,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — RivenTech is excited to move forward. We discussed a phased rollout (pilot -> regional -> global) and have a couple of hard constraints on data migration windows: our ETL team can only accept bulk writes on weekends, and we have a nightly ingestion window between 01:00–03:00 UTC.

Can you draft a mutual action plan that:
- lists milestone owners and dates for pilot -> regional -> global
- proposes concrete migration windows and fallback options
- calls out any API throttling or quota changes needed during cutover

I'm looping in Carlos (engineering) for migration availability.

Best,
Emily Park
Head of Platform Integrations
RivenTech

Attachments: none in this mail
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Emily Park <emily.park@riventech.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: 2028-08-30T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff + MAP for RivenTech phased rollout

Hi Emily — thanks for the clear constraints. Draft attached (RivenTech_MAP_Draft_v1.xlsx) with an initial milestone cadence and proposed migration windows that align to your ETL notes. High level summary below:

Pilot (2 weeks) — internal sampling + sandbox data
- Start: 2028-09-08
- Owner: Ben Carter (Onboarding Eng)
- Migration window: weekend bulk write (2028-09-09 01:00–04:00 UTC)

Regional (APAC pilot then US east) — phased ramp over 6 weeks
- Start: 2028-09-22
- Owner: Marissa Cole (CS Lead)
- Nightly ingestion: 01:00–03:00 UTC; scheduled bulk swaps on weekends only

Global cutover — final sync and SLA checks
- Start: 2028-11-03
- Owner: Neha Kapoor (Launch PM)
- Full data migration: 2028-11-04 weekend window (01:00–06:00 UTC) with throttling rules enabled

API throttling: I've proposed soft quota increases during migration windows and a temporary read-only mode for non-critical flows. See api-throttle-rules.md attached.

Next steps:
1) Carlos/engineering to confirm ETL weekend slot on the dates above.
2) RivenTech to confirm pilot user set by 2028-09-01.
3) We'll publish a locked cutover calendar and calendar invites (cutover-window-calendar.ics) once dates are confirmed.

I'll hold a 30-minute alignment call on Thursday if that works for you — propose 2028-08-31 10:00 PT.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachment: RivenTech_MAP_Draft_v1.xlsx
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: mina_haddad@redwood.com
Cc: Emily Park <emily.park@riventech.com>, carlos.mendes@riventech.com
Date: 2028-08-30T12:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff + MAP for RivenTech phased rollout

Looks good — two quick asks from my side:
1) For the pilot migration window (2028-09-09) can we shorten the bulk write to 3 hours and rely on prefix/KV caching to avoid re-ingesting the full corpus? That'll reduce risk.
2) We should define a rollback trigger (e.g., >5% error rate or latency >1.5s P95 for 10m). I put a note in the draft.

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Cc: Emily Park <emily.park@riventech.com>, carlos.mendes@riventech.com
Date: 2028-08-30T16:30:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: RivenTech cutover owners and contingency plan (please review)

Team — forwarding the draft and Emily's constraints. Please review the ownership and contingency notes below and reply with a single-line ack and any redlines by EOD tomorrow. We'll lock dates with RivenTech after their confirmation.

Ownership (short):
- Pilot execution & sandbox validation: Ben Carter
- Regional rollout playbook & training: Marissa Cole
- Cutover coordination & SLA approval: Neha Kapoor
- Post-cutover regressions & quality: Mina Haddad (ops lead)

Contingency highlights:
- Rollback trigger: >5% error rate OR P95 latency >1.5s sustained for 10 minutes.
- Fallback: switch to read-only mode + route API traffic to dedicated fallback model serving nodes (estimated 10% capacity reserve).
- Communications: status page update + 15-min cadence bridge owned by Ben.

Attachments referenced: RivenTech_MAP_Draft_v1.xlsx, api-throttle-rules.md, cutover-window-calendar.ics

Please reply: ACK / REDLINE (<single line).

Thanks,
Mina

From: Emily Park <emily.park@riventech.com>

Cc: carlos.mendes@riventech.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: 2028-08-31T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan — RivenTech phased rollout & data migration windows

Ack — thanks for the fast turnaround. Carlos confirmed the ETL weekend slots for 2028-09-09 and 2028-11-04. We'll lock pilot user list by 2028-09-01 and confirm calendar invites once you send the .ics.

One small change request: can we add a pre-cutover dry run (sandbox full sync) on 2028-09-06 to validate end-to-end? That will give us one buffer flight before the pilot bulk write.

If that's doable, we consider this MAP approved and will proceed to scheduling.

Best,
Emily
